subject.title: refactor(channels): fix account resolution and setup isolation

question: Should maintainers accept this large shared account-descriptor API and its channel-by-channel behavior contract as the canonical compatibility boundary before it lands?
rationale: The patch changes the common SDK path used by many independently owned channel configurations; deciding whether the selected helper defaults and exceptions are the permanent public plugin boundary requires maintainer ownership judgment beyond a mechanical review.

options.title: Approve the shared boundary after compatibility proof
options.body: Keep the centralized helper design, but require a rebased exact-head review and evidence for the migrated channel-specific account and credential semantics.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Land only the demonstrated Twitch and scoped-credential fixes, leaving broad channel migrations for smaller owner-reviewed follow-ups.

options.title: Pause for API-direction review
options.body: Defer the shared descriptor surface until channel and plugin-SDK owners explicitly agree on its permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared boundary after compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Keep the centralized helper design, but require a rebased exact-head review and evidence for the migrated channel-specific account and credential semantics.
